name: @papercusp/deployment-driver
description: Provider-agnostic deployment abstraction: a DeploymentDriver (provision/install/join/teardown over a Frame handle) selected by an open `target` discriminator, with a built-in no-op `local` driver and a configure*() host seam for cloud backends. Pure, zero domain coupling, zero runtime deps — each backend narrows + validates its own provider config host-side.
